claims.text: The starting material can be a mixture of elemental W, Mo, Ta, Nb, and V powders.
W20Mo20Ta20Nb20V20 can be fabricated by PBF-LB/M using in-situ alloy formation.
NbMoTaW can be fabricated as a single-BCC solid solution by SLM.
A linear energy density of at least 2.83 J/mm is an optimized condition for single-BCC formation.
Favorable PBF-LB/M parameters can produce complete fusion without a significant number of undissolved particles in W20Mo20Ta20Nb20V20.
Optimized additive-manufacturing parameters can produce relative density greater than 99.8%.
Additively manufactured W20Mo20Ta20Nb20V20 has a single BCC phase.
PBF-LB/M produces a dendritic and/or cellular microstructure whose morphology can be controlled to some extent by process parameters.
Rapid solidification during additive manufacturing produces a refined, homogeneous microstructure.
High-temperature annealing homogenizes the additively manufactured refractory HEA microstructure.
High-temperature annealing reduces the concentration or detrimental effects of O, N, and C interstitial impurities.
A single-BCC solid solution with a refined, homogeneous cellular or dendritic microstructure and low interstitial content is the optimal state for mechanical performance.
High configurational entropy stabilizes the single-phase BCC structure in the proposed refractory alloys.
Interstitial O, N, and C form ordered complexes that pin dislocations and reduce ductility.
Annealing minimizes ordered interstitial clustering and thereby facilitates dislocation motion.
The proposed additive-manufacturing and annealing route enhances elevated-temperature strength, ductility, creep resistance, and structural integrity.
The proposed route mitigates brittleness relative to conventionally processed or unannealed additively manufactured refractory HEAs.
Conventional processing of refractory HEAs is challenging because of their high and widely differing melting temperatures and tendency to segregate.
Refractory HEAs based on W, Mo, Ta, and Nb are of interest for high-temperature aerospace and chemical-industry applications.
The exact annealing temperature and duration needed to mitigate interstitial effects without grain coarsening or phase decomposition remain uncertain.
